CORE MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 48
   C. 144
   D. 156

2. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 1
   C. 13
   D. 12

3. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

4. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 50
   C. 49
   D. 14

5. Solve for x: x + 8 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 13
   C. 8
   D. 6

6. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 36
   D. 90

7. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 72
   C. 1
   D. 73

8. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 17
   C. 21
   D. 3

9. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 4

10. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 12
   C. 36
   D. 42

11. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 48
   C. 49
   D. 14

12. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 20
   C. 1
   D. 21

13. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 169
   C. 13
   D. 170

14. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 32
   C. 12
   D. 33

15. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 33
   C. 4
   D. 12

16. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
